text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d t-h-e c-o-v-e-r p-e-r-s-o-n-a a-n-d l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d f-a-l-s-e p-r-o-f-i-l-e s, c-o-m-p-l-e-t-i-n-g t-h-e f-r-a-u-d p-l-a-n w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-a-c-t c-h-e-c-k-s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e-d e-x-p-l-o-i-t-a-t-i-v-e m-s-g-s a-n-d d-r-o-p-p-e-d i-n-c-r-e-a-s-i-n-g p-r-e-s-s-u-r-e n-o-t-e-s, b-u-y-i-n-g t-i-m-e a-n-d a-v-o-i-d-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-a-u-g-h-t r-e-c-i-p-i-e-n-t-s t-o m-o-v-e f-u-n-d-s a-n-d r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d t-h-e s-c-a-m e-s-t-e-p-s i-n n-o-t-e-s, i-s-s-u-i-n-g f-a-k-e o-r-d-e-r-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g k-n-o-w n-s c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-s-s-o-l-a-t-e-d v-i-c-t-i-m-s f-r-o-m o-t-h-e-r-s a-n-d w-r-o-t-e t-h-e i-s-o-l-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l, u-s-i-n-g f-e-a-r t-a-c-t-i-c-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g v-i-c-t-i-m s-a-f-e-t-y.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r h-i-d-d-e n-a-t-u-r-e o-f t-h-e s-c-h-e-m-e a-n-d l-o-g-g-e-d t-h-e c-o-n-s-p-i-r-a-c-y d-e-t-a-i-l-s, s-i-l-e-n-c-i-n-g r-e-p-o-r-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g l-a-w-e-n-f-o-r-c-e-m-e-n-t.
